"""
Hexagonal boss with cylindrical extension and through hole.
Reconstructed from drawing DELTA-2276 (ISO 2768-m, 1:1).
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- Key dimensions (mm) ----------------
ACROSS_CORNERS = 61.5      # hexagon across corners (vertical in front view)
ACROSS_FLATS   = 53.3      # hexagon across flats (horizontal in front view)
TOTAL_LENGTH   = 80.0      # overall length of the part
CYL_LENGTH     = 61.5      # length of the cylindrical boss
CYL_OD         = 38.5      # cylindrical boss OD (scaled from drawing)
HOLE_DIA       = 34.8      # through hole diameter

HEX_LENGTH = TOTAL_LENGTH - CYL_LENGTH   # 18.5 mm hex head thickness

hex_R  = ACROSS_CORNERS / 2.0            # circumradius = 30.75
cyl_R  = CYL_OD / 2.0
hole_R = HOLE_DIA / 2.0

# Hexagon profile: flats perpendicular to X, vertices at top/bottom
hex_pts = [
    (hex_R * math.cos(math.radians(30.0 + 60.0 * i)),
     hex_R * math.sin(math.radians(30.0 + 60.0 * i)))
    for i in range(6)
]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # --- Hexagonal head ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*hex_pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=HEX_LENGTH)

    # --- Cylindrical boss ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(HEX_LENGTH)):
        Circle(cyl_R)
    extrude(amount=CYL_LENGTH)

    # --- Through hole (through head and boss) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(hole_R)
    extrude(amount=TOTAL_LENGTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
IRIS-8007 - circular mounting flange / plate
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.

  top view   : ø80 disc, 8x ø10.9 thru holes on ø43.6 BC,
               central boss carrying 3x ø3.6 holes
  front view : ø80 / ø58.2, heights 5.8 / 8.7 / 10.9, 3x C0.7
  side view  : 40 (half of ø80) and 10.9 overall height
"""

from build123d import *
from math import cos, sin, radians

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_dia    = 80.0    # ø80    outside diameter of the flange
recess_dia   = 58.2    # ø58.2  diameter of the top recess
disc_thk     = 5.8     # 5.8    base disc thickness (= recess floor height)
rim_top      = 8.7     # 8.7    top of the outer rim
total_height = 10.9    # 10.9   overall height (top of the central boss)

boss_dia     = 30.0    # central boss diameter (scaled from the views)
boss_top     = total_height

hole_dia     = 10.9    # ø10.9  8 through holes
hole_bc      = 43.6    # ø43.6  bolt circle
n_holes      = 8

small_dia    = 3.6     # ø3.6   3 small holes in the boss
small_depth  = 7.3     # 7.3    drill depth
small_bc     = 12.0    # bolt circle of the 3 small holes
n_small      = 3
cham         = 0.7     # 3x C0.7

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- main body : full disc up to the rim top ----
    Cylinder(radius=outer_dia / 2, height=rim_top,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- top recess (leaves the raised outer rim) ----
    with Locations((0, 0, disc_thk)):
        Cylinder(radius=recess_dia / 2, height=rim_top - disc_thk,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- central boss rising out of the recess ----
    with Locations((0, 0, disc_thk)):
        Cylinder(radius=boss_dia / 2, height=boss_top - disc_thk,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- 8 through holes on the bolt circle ----
    with Locations(*[(hole_bc / 2 * cos(radians(i * 360 / n_holes)),
                      hole_bc / 2 * sin(radians(i * 360 / n_holes)), 0)
                     for i in range(n_holes)]):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_dia / 2, height=rim_top,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 3 small holes drilled into the boss ----
    with Locations(*[(small_bc / 2 * cos(radians(i * 360 / n_small + 90)),
                      small_bc / 2 * sin(radians(i * 360 / n_small + 90)),
                      boss_top)
                     for i in range(n_small)]):
        Cylinder(radius=small_dia / 2, height=small_depth,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 3x C0.7 chamfers on the small holes ----
    top_edges = [e for e in p.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
                 if abs(e.arc_center.Z - boss_top) < 1e-6
                 and abs(e.radius - small_dia / 2) < 1e-6]
    chamfer(top_edges, length=cham)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
DELTA-6617  –  flat seal ring
Reconstructed from drawing:
    Ø80  outer diameter
    Ø64  inner diameter
    9.1  axial thickness
    2x R1.1  edge rounds on the top face (inner + outer)
    2x R2.7  edge rounds on the bottom face (inner + outer)
"""

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Parameters (from drawing) ----------------
OUTER_DIA = 80.0     # ø80  outer diameter
INNER_DIA = 64.0     # ø64  inner diameter
THICKNESS = 9.1      # 9.1  axial thickness
R_TOP     = 1.1      # 2x R1.1  rounds on top face edges
R_BOT     = 2.7      # 2x R2.7  rounds on bottom face edges

R_OUT = OUTER_DIA / 2.0   # 40.0
R_IN  = INNER_DIA / 2.0   # 32.0

# ---------------- Build ----------------
with BuildPart() as ring:
    # Radial cross-section drawn in the XZ plane
    # (local x = radius, local y = axial direction)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as section:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (R_IN,  0.0),
                (R_OUT, 0.0),
                (R_OUT, THICKNESS),
                (R_IN,  THICKNESS),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

        # 2x R2.7 – bottom corners (z = 0)
        fillet(section.vertices().group_by(Axis.Z)[0], radius=R_BOT)

        # 2x R1.1 – top corners (z = THICKNESS)
        fillet(section.vertices().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], radius=R_TOP)

    # Sweep the section 360° about the Z axis
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

part = ring.part

# ---------------- Sanity check / export ----------------
bb = part.bounding_box()
print(f"Bounding box: {bb.size.X:.2f} x {bb.size.Y:.2f} x {bb.size.Z:.2f} mm")
print(f"Volume: {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
HELIOS-3149 - circular cover / lens plate
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.

Front view : ø80 outside, ø64.9 recess, ø37.7 central boss, small through hole
Side view  : 15.1 thick, R7.5 rounded outer rim
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_dia    = 80.0     # ø80   - outside diameter
thickness    = 15.1     # 15.1  - overall thickness
rim_radius   = 7.5      # R7.5  - rounded outer rim
recess_dia   = 64.9     # ø64.9 - recess outside diameter
recess_depth = 9.1      # 9.1   - recess depth
boss_dia     = 37.7     # ø37.7 - central boss diameter
hole_dia     = 21.0     # central through hole (scaled from view)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # 1) base disc
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=outer_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # 2) round the front outer rim (R7.5)
    front_rim = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    fillet(front_rim, radius=rim_radius)

    # 3) annular recess on the front face (ø64.9 outer, ø37.7 inner, 9.1 deep)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)):
        Circle(radius=recess_dia / 2)
        Circle(radius=boss_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=-recess_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 4) central through hole
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (all dimensions in mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_height      = 80.0      # total height of the glass
base_diameter       = 36.6      # outer diameter of the base
base_thickness      = 1.3       # thickness of the base disc
bowl_rim_diameter   = 36.6      # outer diameter of the bowl rim
bowl_bottom_diameter= 23.2      # diameter of the bowl at the stem junction
stem_diameter       = 6.0       # diameter of the stem (estimated from drawing)
wall_thickness      = 1.5       # glass wall thickness (estimated)

# Derived radii
base_radius         = base_diameter / 2
bowl_rim_radius     = bowl_rim_diameter / 2
bowl_bottom_radius  = bowl_bottom_diameter / 2
stem_radius         = stem_diameter / 2

# Heights (chosen so that base + stem + bowl = overall_height)
stem_height         = 38.7      # from top of base to top of stem
bowl_height         = 40.0      # from top of stem to rim

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outer solid (base + stem + outer bowl)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as outer:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sketch:
        with BuildLine() as line:
            # Base
            Line((0, 0), (base_radius, 0))
            Line((base_radius, 0), (base_radius, base_thickness))
            Line((base_radius, base_thickness), (stem_radius, base_thickness))
            # Stem
            Line((stem_radius, base_thickness), (stem_radius, base_thickness + stem_height))
            # Bowl (spline through three points)
            p1 = (stem_radius, base_thickness + stem_height)
            p2 = (bowl_bottom_radius, base_thickness + stem_height + 5.0)
            p3 = (bowl_rim_radius, overall_height)
            Spline(p1, p2, p3)
            # Top rim and centre line
            Line((bowl_rim_radius, overall_height), (0, overall_height))
            Line((0, overall_height), (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inner cavity (hollow bowl)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as inner:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sketch:
        with BuildLine() as line:
            inner_rim_radius = bowl_rim_radius - wall_thickness
            # Inner bowl points (offset inward by wall_thickness)
            ip1 = (0, base_thickness + stem_height + wall_thickness)          # centre bottom
            ip2 = (bowl_bottom_radius - wall_thickness,
                   base_thickness + stem_height + 5.0 + wall_thickness)      # bowl bottom edge
            ip3 = (inner_rim_radius, overall_height)                         # inner rim
            # Closed wire for the cavity
            Line((0, overall_height), (inner_rim_radius, overall_height))
            Spline(ip3, ip2, ip1)
            Line(ip1, (0, overall_height))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subtract cavity from outer solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = outer.part - inner.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length = 80.0    # obround overall length            (top view)
overall_width  = 33.3    # obround overall width / part depth (top & side views)
part_height    = 33.3    # part height                        (front & side views)
edge_fillet_r  = 2.7     # "4x R2.7" -> fillet on the 4 top edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as obround_block:
    # Obround (stadium) cross-section: 80 long, 33.3 wide,
    # ends are full-radius semicircles (R = 33.3/2 = 16.65)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        SlotOverall(overall_length, overall_width)

    # Extrude to the 33.3 height
    extrude(amount=part_height)

    # Round the top rim: the top face loop consists of 4 edges
    # (2 straight + 2 semicircular arcs) -> 4x R2.7
    top_edges = obround_block.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    fillet(top_edges, radius=edge_fillet_r)

part = obround_block.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of a pin-plate assembly from a multi-view drawing.

Geometry
--------
  * Circular disk : Ø80 x 8 thick
  * 4 pins        : Ø4 x 56 long, arranged in a cross pattern on a
                    Ø56 bolt circle (radius 28), pressed through the
                    disk so they are flush with the back face and
                    protrude 48 mm from the front face.

All dimensions are in millimetres.
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
disk_dia          = 80.0          # Ø80 disk
disk_radius       = disk_dia / 2.0
disk_thickness    = 8.0           # disk thickness (Detail A)

pin_dia           = 4.0           # Ø4 pins
pin_radius        = pin_dia / 2.0
pin_length        = 56.0          # overall pin length (side view)
pin_protrusion    = 48.0          # protrusion beyond front face (Detail A)

pin_circle_radius = 28.0          # radius of pin pattern (Ø56 bolt circle)
num_pins          = 4             # 4 pins, 90° apart (cross pattern)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Disk  (centred on origin, axis along +Z, z = -4 ... +4)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
disk = Cylinder(radius=disk_radius, height=disk_thickness)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pins
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each pin is flush with the back face (z = -disk_thickness/2) and
# extends pin_length along +Z, so its centre lies at:
pin_center_z = -disk_thickness / 2.0 + pin_length / 2.0

pins = []
for i in range(num_pins):
    angle = math.radians(360.0 * i / num_pins)   # 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°
    x = pin_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    y = pin_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    pin = Pos(x, y, pin_center_z) * Cylinder(radius=pin_radius,
                                             height=pin_length)
    pins.append(pin)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine disk + pins into a single solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = disk
for pin in pins:
    part = part + pin

part.label = "pin_plate"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parametric dimensions (interpreted from the drawing)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
L = 80.0                     # overall width  (X)
W = 75.0                     # overall depth  (Y)
H = 37.5                     # overall height (Z)

wall_thickness = 5.0         # side wall thickness
bottom_thickness = 5.0       # bottom wall thickness

fillet_radius = 0.5          # 2x R0.5 internal fillets

# Small tabs on the front wall (seen in the ISO view)
tab_width = 5.0
tab_height = 10.0
tab_thickness = 2.0
tab_offset = 10.0            # distance from the side to the tab

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outer rectangular block
outer = Box(L, W, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# Internal cavity (open at the top)
cavity_L = L - 2 * wall_thickness
cavity_W = W - 2 * wall_thickness
cavity_H = H - bottom_thickness

cavity = Box(cavity_L, cavity_W, cavity_H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
cavity = cavity.translate((wall_thickness, wall_thickness, bottom_thickness))

# Subtract the cavity from the outer block
part = outer - cavity

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply the 2x R0.5 fillets to the internal vertical edges
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
vertical_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
# The internal cavity edges have length equal to cavity_H
inner_edges = [e for e in vertical_edges if abs(e.length - cavity_H) < 1e-6]
if inner_edges:
    part = fillet(inner_edges, radius=fillet_radius)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add the two small tabs on the front wall (Y = 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for x_pos in [tab_offset, L - tab_offset - tab_width]:
    tab = Box(tab_width, tab_thickness, tab_height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    # Position the tab so it protrudes outward from the front face
    tab = tab.translate((x_pos, -tab_thickness, bottom_thickness))
    part = part + tab

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Key dimensions (mm) ----------------
overall_width   = 50.0   # X: overall width of the C-bracket
overall_height  = 80.0   # Y: overall height of the C-bracket
depth           = 10.0   # Z: extrusion depth (side view)
wall_thickness  = 10.0   # back wall and arm thickness

# Derived dimensions
inner_width  = overall_width - wall_thickness          # 40 (opening width)
inner_height = overall_height - 2 * wall_thickness     # 60 (opening height)

# ---------------- Build the part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bracket:
    # C-shaped profile drawn on the XY plane
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile:
        # Outer 50 x 80 rectangle, centered on the origin
        with Locations((overall_width / 2, overall_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(overall_width, overall_height)
        # Inner opening (open to the right), subtracted
        with Locations((wall_thickness + inner_width / 2,
                        wall_thickness + inner_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(inner_width, inner_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    # Extrude the profile 10 mm in +Z
    extrude(amount=depth)

part = bracket.part

# ---------------- Export ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# Key dimensions from the drawing
total_length = 80.0      # overall length
step_length = 70.7       # distance from left end to the step
width = 12.0             # bar width (end view)
base_height = 9.3        # height of the long section
end_height = 17.3        # height of the raised end section

raised_length = total_length - step_length   # 9.3
raised_height = end_height - base_height     # 8.0

with BuildPart() as part:
    # Base bar: 80 long x 12 wide x 9.3 tall
    Box(total_length, width, base_height,
        align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # Raised block on the right end: 9.3 long x 12 wide x 8 tall
    with Locations((step_length, 0, base_height)):
        Box(raised_length, width, raised_height,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
Spoked handwheel - reconstructed from drawing VEGA-7634 (ISO 2768-m)
"""
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
outer_dia      = 80.0    # Ø80        wheel outside diameter
rim_inner_dia  = 72.0    # Ø72 THRU   rim inside diameter (R36)
disc_thick     = 20.0    # 20         axial thickness of rim and spokes
hub_protrusion = 8.0     # 8          hub projection past the front face
hub_dia        = 16.0    # hub outside diameter
bore_af        = 8.0     # 8.0 A/F    square bore (across flats)
spoke_width    = 5.0     # spoke width
n_spokes       = 4       # 4 spokes in a cross
fillet_r       = 2.0     # R2 blend fillets

outer_r     = outer_dia / 2.0
rim_inner_r = rim_inner_dia / 2.0
hub_r       = hub_dia / 2.0
hub_len     = disc_thick + hub_protrusion

# ---------------- 2D front profile ----------------
profile = Circle(outer_r) - Circle(rim_inner_r)          # rim ring

spoke_len = rim_inner_r + 2.0                            # run spokes into the rim
for i in range(n_spokes):
    ang = i * (360.0 / n_spokes)
    profile += Rot(0, 0, ang) * (Pos(spoke_len / 2.0, 0) * Rectangle(spoke_len, spoke_width))

profile += Circle(hub_r)                                 # hub boss

profile = fillet(profile.vertices(), radius=fillet_r)    # R2 blends at spoke junctions

# ---------------- 3D ----------------
wheel = extrude(profile, amount=disc_thick)
hub   = Pos(0, 0, hub_len / 2.0) * Cylinder(hub_r, hub_len)
part  = wheel + hub

# square bore through hub and wheel
part -= Pos(0, 0, hub_len / 2.0) * Box(bore_af, bore_af, hub_len + 2.0)

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
L-shaped bracket reconstructed from the drawing.

Views / dimensions interpreted:
  - Front view : L-profile, overall 80 wide x 80 tall,
                 horizontal leg 18.4 tall, vertical leg 31.8 wide.
  - Top view   : overall width 80.
  - Side view  : thickness (depth) 21.4.
  - Note       : "11x R2" -> R2 rounds on the L-shaped profile edges
                 (6 edges on the front face + 6 on the back face).
"""

from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
overall_width  = 80.0    # overall width  (front / top view)
overall_height = 80.0    # overall height (front view)
depth          = 21.4    # thickness      (side view)
leg_height     = 18.4    # height of the horizontal leg
leg_width      = 31.8    # width of the vertical leg
fillet_r       = 2.0     # "11x R2" rounds

# ---------------- L-shaped profile in the XZ plane ----------------
# (0,0) = bottom-left, vertical leg on the right, horizontal leg at the bottom
profile_pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (overall_width, 0.0),
    (overall_width, overall_height),
    (overall_width - leg_width, overall_height),
    (overall_width - leg_width, leg_height),
    (0.0, leg_height),
]

with BuildPart() as bracket:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile_pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=depth)

    # R2 rounds on the L-shaped profile edges (front and back faces)
    edge_groups = bracket.edges().group_by(Axis.Y)
    profile_edges = edge_groups[0] + edge_groups[-1]
    fillet(profile_edges, radius=fillet_r)

part = bracket.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Stepped spindle / pin - drawing IRIS-5964 (ISO 2768-m)
Reconstructed as a revolved half cross-section about the X axis.

Features:
  - Left head      : dia 10.0
  - Main body      : dia 7.6
  - Right tip      : dia 6.4
  - Ring groove    : 3.2 wide x dia 3.6 (near right end)
  - Chamfers       : 2 x C1.2 (left face + shoulder), C0.4 (right end)
  - Overall length : 80.0
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
total_length  = 80.0     # overall length
d_head        = 10.0     # left head diameter
d_body        = 7.6      # main body diameter
d_tip         = 6.4      # right tip diameter
d_groove      = 3.6      # retaining-ring groove diameter
groove_width  = 3.2      # groove width
l_head        = 20.0     # head length
l_tip         = 10.0     # tip length
chamfer_head  = 1.2      # 2 x C1.2
chamfer_tip   = 0.4      # C0.4
groove_offset = 2.5      # right end -> groove right edge

r_head   = d_head   / 2
r_body   = d_body   / 2
r_tip    = d_tip    / 2
r_groove = d_groove / 2

x_head_end     = l_head
x_tip_start    = total_length - l_tip
x_groove_right = total_length - groove_offset
x_groove_left  = x_groove_right - groove_width

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Half cross-section: X = axis of revolution, Y = radius
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
profile_pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),                            # left face centre
    (0.0, r_head - chamfer_head),          # left face
    (chamfer_head, r_head),                # C1.2 chamfer
    (x_head_end - chamfer_head, r_head),   # head OD
    (x_head_end, r_body),                  # C1.2 shoulder chamfer
    (x_tip_start, r_body),                 # main body
    (x_tip_start, r_tip),                  # step down to tip
    (x_groove_left, r_tip),                # tip up to groove
    (x_groove_left, r_groove),             # groove wall
    (x_groove_right, r_groove),            # groove bottom
    (x_groove_right, r_tip),               # groove wall
    (total_length - chamfer_tip, r_tip),   # tip to end
    (total_length, r_tip - chamfer_tip),   # C0.4 chamfer
    (total_length, 0.0),                   # right face centre
    (0.0, 0.0),                            # close profile
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile_pts)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

part = bp.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
OVERALL    = 80.0     # overall width / height of the cross
ARM        = 40.0     # width of each arm
THICKNESS  = 20.0     # plate thickness
FILLET_R   = 5.0      # 4x R5 inner corner fillets
CHAMFER_C  = 5.0      # 20x C5 chamfers
HOLE_DIA   = 12.1     # central hole diameter
HOLE_DEPTH = 8.0      # central hole depth (blind, from top)

A = ARM / 2.0         # 20  -> half arm width

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cross_pts = [
    ( A,  H), (-A,  H), (-A,  A), (-H,  A),
    (-H, -A), (-A, -A), (-A, -H), ( A, -H),
    ( A, -A), ( H, -A), ( H,  A), ( A,  A),
]

    # 1) Cross shaped base profile
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*cross_pts, close=True)
        make_face()

        # 2) 4x R5 fillets on the concave (inner) corners
        inner_corners = sk.vertices().filter_by(
            lambda v: abs(abs(v.X) - A) < 1e-6 and abs(abs(v.Y) - A) < 1e-6

        fillet(inner_corners, radius=FILLET_R)

    extrude(amount=THICKNESS)

    bot_edges = bp.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0].edges()

"""
COBRA-5018  -  Threaded rod / screw
Reconstructed from drawing: L. ANDERSEN, ISO 2768-m, scale 1:1

Features
  * Ø6.0 threaded shaft, overall length 80.6 mm
  * coarse helical thread (pitch taken from the drawing)
  * slotted head at one end
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters taken from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
D_MAJOR      = 6.0     # Ø6.0  - thread major diameter (3x callout in section)
L_TOTAL      = 80.6    # overall length
PITCH        = 5.0     # thread pitch (16 turns visible over the length)
THREAD_DEPTH = 0.6     # radial thread depth
D_MINOR      = D_MAJOR - 2.0 * THREAD_DEPTH   # 4.8 mm core diameter

HEAD_DIA   = 8.0       # head diameter (slightly larger than shaft)
HEAD_LEN   = 2.5       # head thickness
SLOT_WIDTH = 1.5       # screwdriver slot width
SLOT_DEPTH = 1.5       # screwdriver slot depth

SHAFT_LEN = L_TOTAL - HEAD_LEN

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- shaft core (minor diameter) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(D_MINOR / 2)
    extrude(amount=SHAFT_LEN)

    # ---- helical thread ridge ----
    helix = Helix(pitch=PITCH, height=SHAFT_LEN, radius=D_MINOR / 2, lefthand=False)
    p0 = helix @ 0
    t0 = helix % 0
    radial = Vector(p0.X, p0.Y, 0).normalized()
    prof_plane = Plane(origin=p0, x_dir=radial, z_dir=t0)

    # 60 deg V-thread profile (base slightly buried in the core for a clean union)
    half_w = THREAD_DEPTH * math.tan(math.radians(30.0))
    with BuildSketch(prof_plane):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((-0.1, -half_w), (-0.1, half_w), (THREAD_DEPTH, 0), close=True)
        make_face()
    sweep(path=helix)

    # ---- head ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(SHAFT_LEN)):
        Circle(HEAD_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=HEAD_LEN)

    # ---- screwdriver slot ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(SHAFT_LEN + HEAD_LEN)):
        Rectangle(SLOT_WIDTH, HEAD_DIA + 2.0)
    extrude(amount=-SLOT_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of drawing BRAVO-6678 (G. SCHMIDT, ISO 2768-m, 1:2)

Part: 80 mm cube with a counterbored through-hole on every face
      and 8 mm chamfers on all 12 edges.
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
CUBE_SIZE    = 80.0   # overall cube edge length
EDGE_CHAMFER = 8.0    # 12x C8.0  -> chamfer on all 12 cube edges
CBORE_DIA    = 40.0   # counterbore diameter
CBORE_DEPTH  = 10.0   # counterbore depth
THRU_DIA     = 28.0   # through-hole diameter

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base solid: cube centred at the origin
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = Box(CUBE_SIZE, CUBE_SIZE, CUBE_SIZE)

# Chamfer all 12 edges (12x C8.0)
part = chamfer(part.edges(), EDGE_CHAMFER)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Through holes along the three principal axes (Ø28 THRU)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part -= Cylinder(THRU_DIA / 2, CUBE_SIZE * 2)                  # along Z
part -= Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(THRU_DIA / 2, CUBE_SIZE * 2)  # along Y
part -= Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(THRU_DIA / 2, CUBE_SIZE * 2)  # along X

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Counterbores (Ø40 ↧ 10) on all six faces
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
half      = CUBE_SIZE / 2
cb_center = half - CBORE_DEPTH / 2   # centre of each counterbore cylinder

cbore_defs = [
    (Pos(0, 0,  cb_center), (0,  0, 0)),   # +Z face
    (Pos(0, 0, -cb_center), (0,  0, 0)),   # -Z face
    (Pos(0,  cb_center, 0), (90, 0, 0)),   # +Y face
    (Pos(0, -cb_center, 0), (90, 0, 0)),   # -Y face
    (Pos( cb_center, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0)),   # +X face
    (Pos(-cb_center, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0)),   # -X face
]

for pos, rot in cbore_defs:
    part -= pos * Rot(*rot) * Cylinder(CBORE_DIA / 2, CBORE_DEPTH)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

pyramid_height  = 49.8      # height of the pyramid (Detail A)
fillet_radius   = 3.2       # 7x R3.2 fillets

# Triangle central angles (from drawing): 150.1°, 149.5°, 60.4°
# Orient so one vertex points down (270°) and the short edge is on top
v_angles = [60.1, 120.5, 270.0]

# ---- Build the disc ----
disc = Cylinder(disc_dia / 2, disc_thick,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- Build the triangular pyramid ----
r = pyramid_base_dia / 2
verts_2d = [(r * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
             r * math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in v_angles]

# Apex above the centroid of the triangle
cx = sum(v[0] for v in verts_2d) / 3
cy = sum(v[1] for v in verts_2d) / 3

with BuildPart() as pyramid_bp:
    # Base triangle
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        with BuildLine() as ln:
            Polyline(*verts_2d, close=True)
        make_face()
    # Tiny top face at the apex (loft to a point)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(pyramid_height)) as top_sk:
        with Locations((cx, cy)):
            Circle(0.01)
    loft()

# ---- Position pyramid on top of the disc ----
pyramid = Pos(0, 0, disc_thick) * pyramid

# ---- Combine ----
part = disc + pyramid

# ---- Apply R3.2 fillets to the pyramid edges ----
pyramid_edges = [e for e in part.edges()
                 if e.center().Z > disc_thick + 0.1]
